screen.isekai_mahou.release_forge.title: Shape release: %s
screen.isekai_mahou.release_forge.tip: Pick the effects, augments and laws you want: while the release lasts the effects join your strikes and aura, and the laws hold. The release's look, name and techniques do not change.
screen.isekai_mahou.release_forge.need_f: Requires the Transformation form (Arcane path, Circle %s).
screen.isekai_mahou.release_forge.no_rec: No recipe: the release stays as it always was.
screen.isekai_mahou.release_forge.click: Click to shape it in the Grimoire (Transformation glyph).
hint.isekai_mahou.shinigami_shape_releas: Your release takes the effects you want: menu → Shinigami → Shape release.
